tips.text: Tap Comet Spear to thrust at close range when you want to trade often; it gives back much of its cooldown.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from farther away. It hits much harder against enemies who are low on health, so use it to finish a fight.
Open with Shield Vault to stun the enemy, then follow with your other spells and attacks.
Face the enemy when you cast Aegis Assault. You take no damage from enemies in front of you, except from towers, so use it to block a big hit.
Recast Aegis Assault early if the enemy is about to leave range. The shield slam fires right away.
Watch the Mortal Will counter and plan your spells and attacks so it fills before a fight. Your next spell is stronger once it is full.
Use Shield Vault when Mortal Will is full. Your next attack then strikes three times.
Use Grand Starfall at level 6 to join fights across the map or to finish a fleeing enemy. It slows enemies and fills Mortal Will when you land.
Enemies see Grand Starfall coming and can walk out of it. Cast it where they are heading or at those who cannot move away.

combos.name: Tap Q refund poke
combos.when: Poking in lane when you want to trade often without a long cooldown.
combos.text: Tap Q instead of holding it. The quick thrust refunds much of its cooldown, so you can poke again soon.

tips.text: Hold Comet Spear to throw it from far away, and tap it for a quick thrust up close. The tap gives back most of the cooldown.
Finish low health enemies with a thrown Comet Spear, since it hits much harder against them.
Watch your Mortal Will counter. Plan your spells and attacks so the next fight starts with it ready.
Jump on a target with Shield Vault to stun them, then attack. With Mortal Will ready, your next attack hits three times.
Use Aegis Assault toward the enemy's damage to block it from the front. Recast it early to slam if they are about to leave range.
Use Grand Starfall to join a fight far away. Enemies are slowed by the spear, and landing gives you Mortal Will ready.

combos.name: Shield recast early slam
combos.when: When the enemy is about to leave your shield's range.
combos.text: Recast the shield to slam at once instead of waiting out the full channel. This lets you hit a fleeing target or set up the empowered slam for a chase.

combos.name: Tap Q spear
combos.when: When you want a fast poke or a quicker cooldown on Comet Spear.
combos.text: Tap the key to thrust the spear instead of holding it. The thrust refunds part of the cooldown, so you can use it again sooner, for example on camps.

tips.text: Hold Comet Spear and throw it at low-health enemies; it hits much harder against them and can finish a fleeing carry.
Tap Comet Spear for a quick poke. It gives back much of its cooldown, so you can use it again soon.
Jump on an enemy with Shield Vault to stun them, then have your partner follow up with their damage.
Watch the Mortal Will counter and save a spell for when it is full. The next spell then gets a bonus.
Face the enemy with Aegis Assault to take no damage from that direction. Enemies who get around you can still hurt you.
Recast Aegis Assault early to slam right away if the enemy is about to leave your range.
At level 6, use Grand Starfall to join a fight anywhere on the map. Its long warning means you should pick a spot enemies cannot easily leave.
Grand Starfall leaves enemies slowed where the spear lands, so jump in and have your team chase them down.

combos.name: Spear tap poke
combos.when: Poking in lane when you want Comet Spear back up quickly.
combos.text: Tap Q instead of holding it. A quick thrust refunds much of the cooldown, so you can poke again sooner.

combos.name: Early shield slam recast
combos.when: When an enemy is about to leave your Aegis Assault cone.
combos.text: Recast E during the channel to slam right away. This lets you land the slam and any empowered defensive bonus without waiting.

tips.text: Jump on Aatrox with Shield Vault right after he commits The Darkin Blade; the stun stops him from following up.
Brace with Aegis Assault facing Aatrox when he swings or chains at you; you take no damage from that direction.
Hold Comet Spear to poke from long range, and throw it to finish Aatrox when he is low on health.
Walk out of Infernal Chains toward the sides or toward Aatrox so you are not pulled back.
Trade while Aatrox's Deathbringer Stance is down; its hit heals him, so avoid fighting right after he gets it back.

comboRefs.note: Tapping Q pokes often, which keeps Aatrox from trading freely and limits his healing from hitting you.

tips.text: Hold Aegis Assault facing Briar when she leaps in; you take no damage from her side while you brace, and you hit her as she attacks.
Stun Briar with Shield Vault when she starts to run at you in her frenzy, so you control the fight.
Poke with Comet Spear from long range while she is on cooldown. Hold it to throw it further.
Finish Briar with a thrown Comet Spear when she is low; it hits much harder on weak targets, even after she heals.
Watch for her Certain Death at level 6. Grand Starfall makes you immune to crowd control while you fly, so you can use it to escape her.
Jump on Darius with Shield Vault to stun him, then step out of his reach. Don't stay in melee range, where his Hemorrhage stacks quickly.
Poke Darius with Comet Spear while he walks up. Hold it for long range and thrust it when he is close.
Face Darius with Aegis Assault when he commits. You take no damage from the front, so his Decimate and attacks from that side do nothing.
Stay out of the cone when Darius uses Apprehend. It pulls you in and leaves you slowed, so keep Aegis Assault ready as your answer.
Keep your health up. Noxian Guillotine deals more damage the more Hemorrhage stacks you carry, so don't trade for long.

comboRefs.note: Tap Q pokes from range, letting you trade often without having to fight Darius up close.

tips.text: Wait for Fiora to use Riposte, then stun her with Shield Vault; it is a long wait for her to have it again.
Do not jump on Fiora with Shield Vault while Riposte is ready; she can parry it and stun you.
Poke with Comet Spear from long range while she walks up; hold it to throw it farther.
Face Fiora with Aegis Assault when she lunges in; her attacks from the front cannot hurt you while it lasts.
Finish Fiora with a thrown Comet Spear once she is low on health; it hits much harder then.
Jump on Gangplank with Shield Vault when he has used Remove Scurvy; otherwise he can clear your stun.
Stay out of range of Gangplank's kegs; Parrrley can set them off and slow you.
Use Aegis Assault facing Gangplank when he shoots a keg; you take no damage from that side.
Finish Gangplank with a held Comet Spear when he is low on health; it deals much more damage then.
Watch low-health Gangplank when you reach level 6; Grand Starfall can reach him from far away.
Leave Cannon Barrage's area at once; it slows you and hits many times.
Use Shield Vault to stun Garen when he steps up to last-hit, then trade with your Comet Spear while he is stunned.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from long range and poke Garen. Tap it up close for a quick trade with a short cooldown.
Do not stand in Judgment for long. Hit him and step out, or use Aegis Assault to block his front while you hit back.
Garen's Decisive Strike silences you on his next attack. Keep your distance when it is ready, so you can still cast your spells.
Keep hitting Garen so Perseverance cannot heal him. Spear pokes and trades keep him from regenerating.
Throw Comet Spear to finish Garen when he is low. Stay away from him when you are low, since Demacian Justice finishes you.
Use Aegis Assault facing Jayce when he commits with Thundering Blow or Shock Blast; you take no damage from that direction while you channel.
Jump on Jayce with Shield Vault to stun him, then follow with your empowered triple hit once Mortal Will is ready.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from long range at Jayce when he is low; it hits much harder on weak targets.
Jayce is strong early at range, so tap Comet Spear to trade up close and get the cooldown back quickly.
Use Grand Starfall to finish a hurt Jayce or to join a fight; it slows him and hits hard in a line.

comboRefs.note: Tap Q pokes often, which suits trading with Jayce's Cannon poke; Jayce's Hammer leap can punish.

tips.text: Walk up with a short Comet Spear tap to poke him, since a tap costs little and brings the cooldown back quickly.
Jump on him with Shield Vault when his Ntofo Strikes is on cooldown, so you can stun him without being pulled in.
Use Aegis Assault facing him when he dashes in with Path Maker or Ntofo Strikes, since you take no damage from that direction.
When he goes All Out he is much squishier, so fight him then and finish him with Comet Spear.
Stay out of Malphite's range when Ground Slam is ready; it cuts your Attack Speed and hurts your trades.
Poke him with Comet Spear while he walks up to last-hit; tapping it refunds much of its cooldown.
Jump on Malphite with Shield Vault only when his Granite Shield is already broken; the stun then gives you a free trade.
Stay spread out from your team and watch for Unstoppable Force at level 6; it knocks you up.
Brace with Aegis Assault when Malphite dives in; he cannot hurt you from the front while you channel.
Hold Aegis Assault facing him when he casts Obliterate or Death's Grasp; you take nothing from the front and hit him while he swings.
Stun him with Shield Vault when he walks up to trade, then follow with your Mortal Will empowered attacks.
Poke with Comet Spear from long range early, before Mordekaiser has built up a big Indestructible shield.
Don't stay next to him once his aura is on. Darkness Rise hurts a lot over time, so trade and step away.
Finish him with a thrown Comet Spear when he is low; it hits much harder on weak enemies.
Jump on Rumble with Shield Vault when he has overheated; he can't cast spells then.
Use Aegis Assault facing Rumble when he fires Flamespitter; the front blocks his damage.
Don't stay in the fire of The Equalizer. Move out of it, since it burns and slows.
Rumble deals magic damage, so Aegis Assault's bonus Magic Resist from Mortal Will helps in a trade.
Poke Rumble with Comet Spear and finish him with the hurled spear once he is low.

comboRefs.note: Tapping Comet Spear refunds cooldown, so Pantheon can poke Rumble often and keep his Heat contested.

tips.text: Stay out of Sion's charge line when he starts Decimating Smash; sidestep it, since a full charge stuns you for a long time.
Jump on Sion with Shield Vault to stun him as he starts charging Decimating Smash; this interrupts the big hit.
Poke Sion with Comet Spear while he is far away; hold it for range, and tap it up close for a quick cooldown refund.
Back off when Sion's Soul Furnace shield is up; hitting it wastes your trade, and he can blast you when it ends.
Do not leave Sion nearly dead; Glory in Death brings him back with fast, healing attacks. Back away and wait it out.
Don't walk up to Teemo carelessly; Blinding Dart will make your attacks miss. Wait for it to go on cooldown before trading.
Use Shield Vault to reach Teemo and stun him, then finish the trade fast before his poison builds up.
Watch the bushes: Teemo can be invisible there. Don't step onto unseen ground where his Noxious Trap may be waiting.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from long range, and use it when Teemo is low on health.
Avoid retreating after you get hit. Toxic Shot punishes backing out, so commit to the fight or stay out of range.
Avoid fighting with a wall behind you. Condemn knocks you into it for a stun and heavy damage.
Jump on Vayne with Shield Vault to stun her and shut down her Tumble. She is fragile, so keep the pressure on.
Use Comet Spear to poke Vayne when she walks up to last-hit. Hold it for a longer throw.
Do not trade with Vayne for long stretches. Her third hit or ability on you deals extra true damage with Silver Bolts, so hit and step back.
Use Aegis Assault facing Vayne to block her attacks while you walk up to her.
Use Grand Starfall to finish off a Vayne who has gone low or fled the lane. Her Final Hour makes her harder to catch.

comboRefs.note: Tap Q refunds cooldown, so Pantheon can poke Vayne often and she must close in to trade back.

tips.text: Stun Yone with Shield Vault when he steps up to trade, then follow with your Mortal Will empowered attack.
Use Aegis Assault when Yone commits, and face him. You take no damage from his non-tower hits coming from that direction.
Hold Comet Spear for a longer throw to poke Yone from a distance. Hit him first, and finish him when he is low.
Yone's Soul Unbound sends him back to his body after he trades, so fight him when it is on cooldown.
Look for kills with Grand Starfall. It slows enemies on landing, so use it on a Yone who is already low.
Jump on Graves with Shield Vault when he has spent his shells; he has to reload and can't fight back well, so the stun gets you a free trade.
Hold Comet Spear and throw it when Graves is low on health; it hits much harder against weakened enemies.
Use Aegis Assault facing Graves when he shoots; you take no damage from his front, so his shotgun pellets can't hurt you.
Land Shield Vault first when you want to fight; Graves is stunned and can't use Quickdraw to dash away.
Use Grand Starfall to join a fight or chase Graves from far away; the spear slows him when it lands.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his flag to avoid being knocked up.
Brace with Aegis Assault facing Jarvan when he dives, because it blocks damage from the front.
Stun Jarvan with Shield Vault right after he spends Dragon Strike, when he has little to escape with.
Finish a low-health Jarvan with a held Comet Spear; it hits much harder on weak targets.
Do not trade inside a Cataclysm arena. Fight outside it or wait for the walls to drop.
Hold Comet Spear and hurl it at Kayn when he is low on health; it hits much harder against weakened enemies and can finish him.
Stun Kayn with Shield Vault when he commits, then follow up with your empowered attack.
Face Kayn with Aegis Assault when he dives in; you take no damage from the front while it channels, so turn it toward him.
Use Grand Starfall to reach a fight or an escaping Kayn across the map; the spear slows enemies where it lands.
Stay near allied minions or champions when Kha'Zix is around; his Taste Their Fear hits far harder on an enemy who is isolated.
Use Shield Vault on Kha'Zix when he jumps in; he is stunned and cannot answer right away.
Face Kha'Zix with Aegis Assault when he dives. Damage from the front is blocked, so he wastes his burst.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it when Kha'Zix is low on health; it hits much harder on weak targets.
Look for a fight when Kha'Zix has used Leap and Void Assault; he has little way to escape.

comboRefs.note: Recasting Aegis Assault slams at once, so it can hit Kha'Zix when he leaps or turns invisible to flee.

tips.text: Hunt Kindred early with Shield Vault; she is fragile, and the stun keeps her from kiting away.
Hold Aegis Assault facing Kindred when she is about to hit you; you take no damage from that direction.
Hurl Comet Spear when Kindred is low on health; it deals much more damage to weakened enemies.
Do not dive into Lamb's Respite expecting a kill; no one inside can die. Back off and return once it ends.
Use Grand Starfall to catch Kindred in a fight or chase; it slows those it hits.
Stay out of Lee Sin's Sonic Wave line and keep your distance. If it lands, he can dash onto you.
Use Shield Vault on Lee Sin when he dashes in, to stun him and stop his chain.
Hold Aegis Assault toward Lee Sin when he commits. Facing him blocks his damage from the front.
Stay spread out from your team, so Dragon's Rage can't knock Lee Sin's target into others.
Hit Lee Sin with magic damage like Grand Starfall. He has tools against physical damage.

comboRefs.note: Early Aegis Assault slam can catch Lee Sin as he dashes away with Safeguard.

tips.text: Stun Master Yi with Shield Vault when he commits, then fight him while he is held.
Hold Aegis Assault facing Master Yi so his basic attacks from the front do nothing to you. Face him as he runs in.
Don't rely on Grand Starfall's slow when Master Yi has Highlander active; he ignores slows then. Use Shield Vault to stop him.
Hurl Comet Spear at Master Yi when he is low on health, such as after Meditate fails to heal enough, to finish him off.
Use Aegis Assault to face Naafiri when she dives in; her hits from the front do nothing while you brace, so turn it toward her and wait.
Jump on Naafiri with Shield Vault when she commits, so she is stunned and cannot chain her spells.
Finish her with a held Comet Spear once she is low on health; it hits much harder then.
Do not use Shield Vault while she is untargetable from The Call of the Pack; wait until she is visible again.
Hold Shield Vault until Nocturne has used Shroud of Darkness, or the stun is blocked.
Face Nocturne with Aegis Assault when he dashes in with Paranoia; you take no damage from that direction while it lasts.
Walk out of range when Nocturne casts Unspeakable Horror so the tether breaks and you are not feared.
Poke with Comet Spear from range; it can finish Nocturne when he is low.
Avoid fighting on his Duskbringer trail; he moves faster and hits harder there.
Hold Comet Spear and hurl it when Shyvana is low on health; it hits much harder against weakened enemies.
Jump on Shyvana with Shield Vault to stun her before she can start attacking, then keep hitting her.
Face Shyvana and use Aegis Assault when she attacks; you take no damage from the front while it channels.
Keep your distance and poke with Comet Spear while her Dragon Fury is low; she is weak when she cannot hit you.
Use Grand Starfall to catch her off guard from far away; it slows her and hits hard.
Stun Skarner with Shield Vault when he charges in with Ixtal's Impact; a stun stops the charge.
Stay away from walls when Skarner grabs you; hitting one stuns you and deals damage.
Do not fight him for long; his attacks stack Quaking and the damage adds up.
Dodge Impale sideways or with Flash; it hits only a line in front of him.
Throw Comet Spear at Skarner once he is low on health, as it hits harder on weak targets.
Hold Comet Spear and hurl it when Sylas is low; it hits much harder on weak targets and finishes him from range.
Jump on Sylas with Shield Vault to stun him before he can chain you, then follow up with your empowered triple strike.
Face Sylas when you use Aegis Assault; you take no damage from that direction, so his chains and bursts from the front can't hurt you.
Sylas can copy Grand Starfall, so use it only when it wins a fight, and don't throw it at him when he can steal it.

comboRefs.note: Recasting E early slams at once, so it can catch Sylas as he dashes away with Abscond.

tips.text: Stay alert when Talon vanishes with Shadow Assault; he can reappear on you. Stand near allies and keep Shield Vault ready to stun him when he shows up.
Face Talon and use Aegis Assault when he dives in. You take no damage from the front, so his burst lands on the shield.
Do not hold Aegis Assault against Talon's Noxian Diplomacy from behind. Talon can leap over terrain and strike from a side you are not facing.
Pick off a weakened Talon with a held Comet Spear; it hits much harder against low-health enemies.
Use Grand Starfall to chase Talon down once his escape is spent; the spear slows him.

comboRefs.note: Recasting E early slams at once, helping hit Talon when he turns invisible or vaults away.

tips.text: Hold Comet Spear to hurl it when Viego is low on Health; it hits much harder against weak enemies and can finish him.
Stun Viego with Shield Vault before he can start a fight on his terms, then follow up with your empowered attack.
Face Viego when you use Aegis Assault; you take no damage from his side while you brace, so wait out his burst behind it.
Use Grand Starfall to reach a fight across the map, and land the spear to slow Viego so he cannot run.
Kill Viego cleanly; a dead enemy near him can become a wraith he uses to heal and take their powers, so don't leave a fallen ally exposed.
Stay away from Xin Zhao's third Three Talon Strike, which knocks you up. Back off or stun him first with Shield Vault.
Face Xin Zhao with Aegis Assault when he dives in. You take no damage from the front while it lasts.
Hold Comet Spear and finish Xin Zhao with the throw once he is low on health.
Step out of the area when you see Grand Starfall coming; the warning gives you time. Avoid clumping up with allies until Xin Zhao has used Crescent Guard.
Move away from Wind Becomes Lightning's long thrust; it slows you and reveals you.
Keep your distance from Alistar when Pulverize and Headbutt are both ready; the combo can lock you down, especially near turrets.
Throw Comet Spear from long range to wear Alistar down before you jump in. He is tough, so aim for his carry instead.
Face Alistar with Aegis Assault when he commits his combo; it blocks his damage from the front.
Do not hit Alistar while Unbreakable Will is active. Back off and wait for it to end.
Use Shield Vault on the enemy carry instead of Alistar. Alistar is too tough to kill, and the stun leaves their carry open.
Dodge Flash Frost by staying out of its line, and never stand at the end of its range, where it stuns.
Jump in with Shield Vault when Flash Frost is on cooldown; Anivia has little to stop you then.
Check where Crystallize stands before you leap; the wall blocks your way and can push you aside.
Stand in Aegis Assault facing Anivia to ignore her spells coming from that side, then slam her.
Hold Comet Spear to finish Anivia once she is low on health; she is weak in the early game.
Anivia returns as an egg when she dies, so kill the egg too; gank with a teammate to make sure of it.
Hold Comet Spear and release it at a long range to poke Bard when he walks up for chimes. Tap it up close for a quick thrust with a short cooldown.
Jump on Bard with Shield Vault right after he misses Cosmic Binding. He can't easily fight back while you have him stunned.
Face Bard and use Aegis Assault when Cosmic Binding is coming at you. You take no damage from that direction while you channel.
Walk over Bard's Caretaker's Shrines to destroy them. His team then loses the healing and the speed boost.
Don't stand beside a wall when Bard has Cosmic Binding ready. Hitting terrain stuns you, so stay away from walls.
Look for the stasis circle from Tempered Fate and don't jump into it. Use Grand Starfall after it ends, when the enemy has lost their escape.
Stay behind minions so Rocket Grab hits one of them first and not you.
Hold Comet Spear to hit Blitzcrank from long range when he is low on health; it hurts much more against low-health targets.
Use Shield Vault to stun Blitzcrank when he is out of position, then follow up with your attacks.
Face Blitzcrank with Aegis Assault when he throws a grab; the shield blocks damage from that direction.
Do not fight Blitzcrank at level 6 if his Static Field is ready; it silences you for a moment and breaks your shield.
Dodge Brand's first Sear or Pillar of Flame. He needs one spell to land before his combo can start.
Brace Aegis Assault toward Brand when he casts Sear, since you take no damage from that direction.
Jump on Brand with Shield Vault to stun him, then hit him hard. He is fragile and has no escape of his own.
Hold Comet Spear and throw it from range at Brand. It hits harder against low-health enemies.
Stay away from your ally when Brand casts Pyroclasm, so it bounces to fewer targets.
Walk around Braum's Unbreakable instead of attacking into it; hits from the front do almost nothing while it is up. Wait for it to end or hit him from the side.
Use Aegis Assault to block the front when you walk into his Winter's Bite range; it protects you from enemies in that direction.
Do not let Braum and his ally stack Concussive Blows on you; leave before the fourth hit lands and stuns you.
Jump on the enemy carry with Shield Vault, not on Braum. The stun lets your lane partner follow up.
Hold Comet Spear to hurl it at long range and finish low health enemies. Braum's Winter's Bite can stop your approach, so stay out of its line.
Dodge Glacial Fissure during its long cast and avoid walking on the ice, which slows you.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from long range, and use it to finish Camille when she is low on health.
Stand in front of Camille and hold Aegis Assault when she dives in with Hookshot. She cannot hurt you from the front, and you hit her while you wait.
Jump on Camille with Shield Vault to stun her, then follow with your empowered attack for a strong trade.
Camille's Tactical Sweep slows and heals her only on the outer half of the cone. Stay out of its edge, or step in close so you avoid the slow.
Watch for Camille's Hextech Ultimatum on your partner. Once it lands, stay out of the zone unless you can win the fight.
Save Shield Vault for when Janna uses her shield or has no Howling Gale ready; she is easy to stun and burst.
Janna's Monsoon knocks you back and shuts down a dive. Hold your jump until it is used.
Listen for Howling Gale charging from brush or off screen; step aside so it cannot knock you up.
Poke Janna's partner with Comet Spear; she is weakest when she cannot buff them.
Stay out of Karma's Inner Flame line; minions in front of you will stop it. Every hit she lands makes Mantra come back sooner.
Jump in with Shield Vault to stun her when her Focused Resolve is on cooldown. She has little else to stop you.
Break Focused Resolve by moving out of its reach, or use Aegis Assault to push on. Otherwise you get rooted.
Hold Comet Spear and throw it at a low-health Karma; it hits much harder against weak targets.
Brace Aegis Assault toward Leona when she runs in; you ignore her damage from that direction while it lasts.
Hold Comet Spear back and throw it from long range at Leona when she walks up; it keeps going through a minion line to hit others too.
Stay out of Zenith Blade range, because it roots you and pulls Leona in for her stun. Step out of its line when you see her start the cast.
When Leona raises Eclipse, back off instead of trading; she takes less damage and keeps the bonus longer if her shield hits you.
Move out of the center of Solar Flare; only the middle stuns you, and the edge only slows.
Jump on the enemy carry with Shield Vault when Leona has used her stun; the stun lets you follow up with Comet Spear.

comboRefs.note: Recasting E early slams right away, so Leona can't easily slip out of the cone before it lands.

tips.text: Jump on Lulu with Shield Vault when she is out of position; the stun gives you a second to burst her down.
Stay out of her line of fire; Glitterlance leaves you slowed, so dodge it before you commit.
Poke with Comet Spear and hold it for longer range. Lulu has low health early, so the damage adds up.
Face Lulu with Aegis Assault when she tries to trade. You take no damage from the front while it lasts.
Keep Shield Vault ready for a dive. Lulu's Whimsy can turn you into a critter, so jump when she has used it.
Stay out of Light Binding's line, ideally behind a minion, because it roots only the first two enemies it hits and it is slow to fly.
Jump on Lux with Shield Vault when her Light Binding is on cooldown. The stun keeps her from fighting back and she has few ways out.
Hold Comet Spear for long-range poke, and release it quickly for a short thrust that gives back much of its cooldown.
Use Aegis Assault to block her Final Spark when it comes from the front, then face her so the beam hits your shield.
Finish a weakened Lux with a hurled Comet Spear, because it hits much harder against low health.
Step out of Lucent Singularity's zone instead of staying in it, since it slows you and then bursts.
Jump on Maokai with Shield Vault only when you are ready to fight. His Twisted Advance can root you when you are out of position.
Hit Maokai with few spells. Each one you land or he casts shortens the cooldown on his Sap Magic heal.
Stay out of brush where Maokai may have left a Sapling Toss. Brush saplings hit harder and slow you.
Look for a Comet Spear finish when Maokai is low on health. Hold the charge to throw it from far away.
Aim Grand Starfall away from Nature's Grasp. Plan your landing so it cannot catch you.
Use Aegis Assault when Mel's Solar Snare or Radiant Barrage is coming from the front; it blocks damage from that direction.
Wait for Mel to spend Rebuttal before you throw Comet Spear. Her nova destroys projectiles that hit it.
Jump on Mel with Shield Vault right after she uses Solar Snare. She is then easy to stun and burst.
Back off when you are low. Mel's Overwhelm stacks will kill you with her next hit or Golden Eclipse.
Finish Mel with a thrown Comet Spear once she is low; it hits much harder on weak targets.
Look for roams with Grand Starfall once Mel has used her spells; the warning gives her time, so aim where she must stand.
Jump on Milio with Shield Vault when his Ultra Mega Fire Kick is on cooldown; the stun gives you a free few seconds on him.
Catch Milio when he is away from his allies, since he moves worse alone. Go in when his partner is out of position.
Sidestep the fireball from Ultra Mega Fire Kick; it hits the first enemy in its path, so keep a minion from blocking it only if you want to be shielded.
Hold Aegis Assault facing Milio's fireball or his partner's attacks; you take no damage from the front while it channels.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from long range and poke Milio, especially once he is low on health.
Stay behind minions so Morgana's Dark Binding hits them instead of you; it stops at the first enemy.
Wait for Morgana to use Dark Binding before you leap in with Shield Vault.
If Morgana puts Black Shield on herself or her partner, your Shield Vault stun will not work until the shield breaks.
Use Aegis Assault facing Morgana to walk through her damage, but leave the area when Tormented Shadow lands, because it does not care about your shield.
Look for Comet Spear on Morgana when she is low; it deals much more damage to low-health targets.
Stay out of Soul Shackles range at level 6, or break away from her before the chains pull tight, so you avoid the stun.
Jump on Nami with Shield Vault when Aqua Prison is on cooldown; the stun keeps her from answering, and she cannot easily escape.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from far away, and finish Nami with it once she is low on health.
Use Aegis Assault facing Nami's bubble or her allies' attacks; you take no damage from that direction while it channels.
Do not fight an enemy who has Tidecaller's Blessing active; wait a few seconds for it to run out.
Watch Tidal Wave; it is slow, so step out of its path sideways instead of walking away from it.
Hold Aegis Assault in front of you when Nautilus aims Dredge Line at you; you are immune to damage from that direction, so he cannot hurt you head-on.
Stay out of a straight line with Nautilus and keep minions or walls between you; Dredge Line stops on the first enemy it hits.
Wait out Riptide's waves before you run; leaving early walks you into the later explosions and you get slowed.
Jump on Nautilus with Shield Vault when his Dredge Line is on cooldown. The stun lets you land your follow-up hits safely.
Poke with a tapped Comet Spear from range. It comes back fast, so you can keep pressure on Nautilus.
Break his Titan's Wrath shield before you stay in a long fight; while it holds, his attacks hurt everyone around the target.
Use Grand Starfall at level 6 to finish a hurt Nautilus or to join a fight elsewhere. His spells cannot reach you while you are in the air.
Jump on Neeko with Shield Vault when she has no Tangle-Barbs ready; the stun keeps her from fighting back.
Hold Aegis Assault facing Neeko when she throws Tangle-Barbs or Blooming Burst; you take no damage from that direction.
Hit Neeko with Comet Spear when she is low on health; it deals much more damage to weak targets.
Be wary of a disguised Neeko; if an ally looks odd, back off, because Pop Blossom can come from nowhere.
Stay out of a line with minions in front of you; Tangle-Barbs gets stronger after it hits one enemy.

comboRefs.note: Tapping Comet Spear lets you poke Neeko again quickly while she is zoned in lane.
Recasting Aegis Assault early slams right away, so Neeko has less time to react to the cone.

tips.text: Cast Shield Vault from outside Steadfast Presence, or wait until the field ends. Poppy can stop your dash.
Stay away from walls when Poppy is close. Heroic Charge stuns you if it slams you into terrain.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from range. Use it to poke Poppy before you commit.
Step on Poppy's dropped buckler to destroy it and deny her the shield from Iron Ambassador.
Do not stand in Poppy's line when she charges Keeper's Verdict. It can send you back toward your base.
Hit Pyke with Shield Vault when he commits; the stun gives you time to hit him with your attacks.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from far away and wear Pyke down. It hits harder against low health enemies.
Face Pyke with Aegis Assault when Bone Skewer or Phantom Undertow is coming. You take no damage from the front while it channels.
Do not chase Pyke after he vanishes. Ghostwater Dive hides him and he heals back damage you dealt.
Jump on Rakan with Shield Vault when he is away from his partner; it stuns him, and he is easy to catch alone.
Poke Rakan with Comet Spear before you engage; hold it for the long throw, or tap it for a quick thrust at close range.
Use Aegis Assault when Rakan's allies dive at you; you take no damage from the direction you face, so face them.
Stay out of Grand Entrance's landing spot. Its dash shows where it is going, and it knocks you up after a short delay.

comboRefs.note: Tap Q poke gets Comet Spear back fast, useful for trading into Rakan's shield-reliant, dash-based play.

tips.text: Walk behind Rell or wait out Aegis Assault when she braces; you take no damage from the front while it lasts.
Stay out of Rell's Shattering Strike line. It stuns, and it also destroys your shields.
Jump in with Shield Vault when Rell has used her stun and Ferromancy: Crash Down; the enemy is then easy to catch and stun.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from long range at low health enemies. It hits harder against them.
Fight Rell in short trades. Each hit she lands makes her tougher, so don't stand in a long brawl.
Move away when Rell starts Magnet Storm, or use Aegis Assault to hold position. It pulls you in and hurts.
Jump on Senna with Shield Vault when she steps up for a Mist Wraith or a last hit; the stun lets you hit her without answer.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from long range when Senna is low on health; it hits much harder on weak targets.
Stay out of Last Embrace's line; if you are rooted, Senna and her partner get free hits. Walk sideways or behind minions to dodge it.
Brace with Aegis Assault facing Senna when she fires at you; it blocks damage from the front, but not from the sides or behind.
Senna outranges you more as she collects Mist, so close the gap with Shield Vault early instead of trading at range.
Use Grand Starfall to finish a hurt Senna or to roam; it slows enemies and the landing gives your next spell a bonus.
Save Shield Vault for when Seraphine has used Beat Drop; she is easiest to stun and trade with while it is on cooldown.
Use Aegis Assault facing Seraphine when she throws spells at you; you take no damage from that direction except from towers.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from far away. It hits harder against a low-health Seraphine.
Tap Comet Spear for a quick thrust when she is close; it gives back much of its cooldown.
Seraphine's Encore charms from far away, so stay out of line with her or fight near cover once you reach level 6.
Jump on Shen with Shield Vault when he steps up to the wave, so he is stunned before he can use Shadow Dash.
Do not stand in front of Shen's Shadow Dash path. Step out of its line so you are not taunted into his team.
Hold Comet Spear and throw it from long range to poke Shen. It does extra damage once he is low on health.
Use Aegis Assault when Shen's allies rush you, but face them. It blocks damage only from the front.
Watch for Shen's Stand United after level 6. If he vanishes from lane, expect him to arrive beside an ally you are fighting.
Jump on Sona with Shield Vault when she steps forward to poke. The stun stops her from casting and she is easy to burst.
Walk into her poke with Aegis Assault facing her. You take no damage from that direction while the shield is up.
Stay out of Crescendo range when you can. Being stunned in front of her team usually gets you killed.
Throw Comet Spear at Sona when she is low. It deals far more damage to low-health enemies, and she has few ways to escape.
Hold your jump until she has used Song of Celerity or Aria of Perseverance. Her heal and shield make an early trade much weaker.
Look for Shield Vault on Soraka when she is out of position; she is fragile and the stun lets you kill her.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from far away, and use it to finish Soraka when she is low.
Dodge Equinox; stay out of the field so you are not silenced and rooted. Go in after it has been used.
Sidestep Starcall; when it hits, it slows you and heals her, so it wins her trades.
Brace with Aegis Assault facing Soraka's allies to take their damage, then slam. Her heals are weak against burst.
Don't stand at the edge of Swain's range. Stay out of his Death's Hand range or close the gap quickly, since the bolts hurt most up close.
Hold Shield Vault until Nevermove is used, because a rooted Pantheon is easy to pull and punish.
Face Swain with Aegis Assault when he casts Nevermove or Death's Hand, then slam to close the gap.
Keep moving when Vision of Empire appears; it takes a while to explode, so step out of it to avoid the slow.
Throw Comet Spear when Swain is low on health, because it hits much harder against low-health enemies.
Stay out of Tongue Lash range; it slows you, and with three stacks of An Acquired Taste it stuns you too.
Do not let Tahm Kench poke you into three stacks, because then he can Devour you.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from long range, and finish enemies who are low on health.
Brace with Aegis Assault facing Tahm Kench when he lashes at you; you take no damage from that direction.
When you see the landing marker for Abyssal Dive, step out of it. You can stun him with Shield Vault while he channels.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from far away. It hits harder on low-health enemies, so use it to finish Taric or his carry.
Jump with Shield Vault on a target Taric hasn't shielded. It stuns them, but Dazzle can punish you right afterward.
Taric's Dazzle takes a moment to burst, so keep moving after he casts it and step out of the beam.
Taric reduces his cooldowns by attacking with Bravado. Punish him when he walks up to the minions.
Use Grand Starfall to hit enemies away from Taric. Hit before Cosmic Radiance arrives, because it makes them invulnerable.
Hold Aegis Assault facing Thresh when his Death Sentence or Flay is coming; you take no damage from that direction while it lasts.
Watch Thresh's cast start for Death Sentence; it has a long cast time, so sidestep it. The scythe stops at the first enemy it hits, so stay behind your minions.
Jump in with Shield Vault to stun Thresh once his Death Sentence is on cooldown, then follow up with Comet Spear.
Hold Comet Spear and throw it at Thresh when he is low on health; it hits much harder against weak targets.
Use Grand Starfall to finish a fleeing target or join a fight elsewhere. Thresh's The Box can still slow you once you land, so land at the edge of his reach.

comboRefs.note: Tapping Q lets Pantheon poke Thresh again sooner, keeping pressure up between Thresh's hooks.

tips.text: Jump on Vel'Koz with Shield Vault as soon as he spends Tectonic Disruption or Void Rift; he has little way to get away from you.
Hold Aegis Assault toward Vel'Koz when he casts at you; you take no damage from the front while you channel.
Shield Vault stuns, so use it to interrupt Life Form Disintegration Ray before it deals much damage.
Finish a low-health Vel'Koz with a hurled Comet Spear; it hits much harder against low-health enemies.
Stay out of Plasma Fission's line, since it slows you and splits to catch you at range.
Jump on Xerath with Shield Vault as soon as he starts charging Arcanopulse or lands a Shocking Orb; he cannot stop you, and you stun him.
Stay out of a straight line with Xerath when Shocking Orb is ready; it stuns the first enemy it hits, so walk at an angle or keep a minion between you.
Hold Aegis Assault toward Xerath when his spells come at you; you take no damage from that direction while it lasts.
Walk at Xerath instead of away from him; closing the distance is how you beat his range.
Hold Comet Spear to hurl it from long range once he is low on health; it hits much harder then.
When Xerath channels Rite of the Arcane, dive in with Shield Vault; he is stuck in place and you stun him.

comboRefs.note: Early E recast slams fast, and Aegis Assault blocks damage from the direction Xerath fires from.

tips.text: Jump on the enemy carry with Shield Vault when Yuumi is attached; she can't be targeted while attached, so the stun lands on her partner.
Hit Yuumi with Comet Spear when she is detached; she can only be hit while she is off her partner.
Use Aegis Assault to walk through her Prowling Projectile when it comes from the front; you take no damage from that direction.
Finish low-health enemies with a hurled Comet Spear; it hits much harder on them.
Save Grand Starfall for when the enemy pair is hurt, then fight them while they are slowed.
Move out of the way of Time Bomb right after it lands; if two bombs hit you, you get stunned.
Jump on Zilean with Shield Vault when his Time Bomb and Rewind are on cooldown; he is fragile and hard to escape once stunned.
Hold Comet Spear to finish Zilean or his partner when low on health; it hurts more against weakened enemies.
If Zilean puts Chronoshift on his carry, wait for it to end before you strike the killing blow.
Brace with Aegis Assault facing Zilean when he is about to bomb you; you take no damage from that direction.
Step on Zyra's seeds before she can grow them, or stay out of the area around them. Walking over a seed destroys it.
Jump on Zyra with Shield Vault as soon as she uses Grasping Roots or Deadly Spines. The stun makes it hard for her to escape.
Face Zyra with Aegis Assault when her Grasping Roots or plants are about to hit you. You take no damage from the front, only from the sides and behind.
Hold Comet Spear to throw it from range at Zyra when she is low on health. It hits much harder against low-health enemies.
Get away from the area when Stranglethorns lands. It knocks you up after a short delay, so leave before the vines snap up.
Use Grand Starfall to reach Zyra when she is out of position. She can't easily escape it.

comboRefs.note: Tap Q pokes often, which suits trading with Zyra and keeping her off her seeds.
